cards.name: Teddy Greetings
cards.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished vintage postcard artwork for a website, one card only, portrait 2:3. Create an original 1940s lithographed greeting postcard: two warm brown teddy bears with expressive hand-painted eyes, rosy cheeks, one pink ribbon and one navy polka-dot bow, carrying small baskets of red and blue garden flowers. Charming period proportions, delicate fur stippling and layered ink, genuine aged cream paper with subtle print wear, softly scalloped illustrated border. Rich brown, faded coral, cornflower blue, butter cream. Small elegant handwritten caption exactly 'For you'. Full-bleed FLAT FRONT card art filling image, no tabletop, no mockup, no perspective, no cast shadow around card, no watermark. Detailed antique illustration, not modern vector, not plastic 3D. User reference teddy greeting cards are mood/style guidance, create a fresh composition.
